market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from Hormuz escalation, 60% Fed hike probability, and global bond selloff. Oil above trend, yields rising, equities under pressure. Expect elevated VIX (25-35 range). Credit spreads may widen if Hormuz disruption persists beyond 2 weeks. Tech rotation from megacaps to infrastructure/operators likely.
market_outlook.long_term: US $40T debt trajectory and AI capex cycle create structural tension. Energy transition (data centers as power hubs) and custom silicon demand support 12-month upside in select tech. EM divergence continues: SA/India constructive, Pakistan/Korea cautious. Housing affordability remains a multi-year drag on consumer spending. AI integration into financial systems (BoE warning) could create regulatory overhang by Q1 2027.
